text.title: Legacy orders table against the migrated copy
text.lede: All 6,000 rows at once, in key order. Scattered marks are one-off defects. A solid block is a batch that failed. Move the lens along the strip to read the rows underneath it.
text.mapSub: Table customer_orders, extract of 31 March 2026. Select anywhere on the strip to move the lens.
text.profSub: Rows with a difference in each column.
